string.text: $clr_1Sakharov $clr_2Stalkers, reminder: during mutant migration cleanups and underground breaches a ceasefire is in effect. Do not open fire on military stalkers, mercenaries, or bandits — they will not open fire on you. Breaking the ceasefire costs reputation; a second violation means death. Also: experimental injectors are ineffective during such mutant concentrations and are not recommended.
